query: Please implement a web-based application for creating and managing Playdoh projects. The application should have functionalities for creating, editing, and deleting projects. Users should be able to log in and browse the project list, create new projects, edit existing projects, and delete unnecessary projects. Additionally, the application should have project preview and sharing functions. Color the background using ice blue and set component styles to teal.
